name: CALPHAD & Integrated Computational Materials Engineering
summary: Covers computational thermodynamics (CALPHAD) and how linked process-structure-property models (ICME) are used to design alloys and processes faster.

topics.name: The CALPHAD method: Gibbs energy models for pure elements and solution phases
Sublattice (compound energy) models for ordered and intermetallic phases
Tools: Thermo-Calc, Pandat, OpenCalphad and pycalphad
ICME concept: linking process, structure, property and performance models
Materials Genome Initiative and accelerated alloy design
ICME case studies: aerospace alloys, AM process optimisation, automotive steels
Uncertainty quantification and model calibration in ICME
